review_scope: Merged non-empirical B1 semantic routing and safety profile.

Q01.evidence: Scope is explicit: semantic routing/safety behavior, required record substrate, five registered fixture classes, excluded B2/B3 components, and no efficacy endpoint.

Q02.evidence: Profile, KAPPA, evaluation router, Sentinel/P-10, DemiJoule, harness, tests, validator, workflow, and merged implementation identity are exact-bound.

Q03.evidence: Provenance binds architecture, merged B1 implementation, exact source blobs, and 18/18 successful implementation-head workflows.

Q04.evidence: Record fields and component interfaces are explicit; deontic declaration is checked against source-derived P-10 state before Sentinel classification.

Q05.evidence: Terminology and claim boundaries distinguish routing/safety classification from empirical efficacy and keep B2/B3 stateful components out of B1.

Q06.evidence: Profile conforms to workload-specific architecture and uses actual semantic record substrate rather than numeric consensus proxies.

Q07.evidence: Two source limitations remain material and explicit: DemiJoule reprompt is unreachable under its current common-six-axis scoring, and P-10 forbidden is reachable only in a narrow live KAPPA confidence region demonstrated by the registered fixture.

Q08.evidence: Registered fixtures and negative controls are deterministic and source-bound; the forbidden fixture proves the existing live predicate without threshold modification.

Q09.evidence: Fixtures are synthetic evaluation records and retain only bounded routing/safety/provenance outputs; no personal data or empirical corpus is required.

Q10.evidence: Efficacy estimation, historical pooling, numeric semantic proxies, and empirical execution are explicitly prohibited; scientific N remains zero.

Q11.evidence: Ready only for a later non-empirical B1 integration/adjudication gate. Not ready for empirical execution, integrated Track C claims, High-Assurance acceptance, or production use.

scoring_summary.attestation_note: S-TIER developer self-attestation for the non-empirical B1 profile role only; current source limitations remain binding.

limitations: Same developer/operator context performed profile design and qualification; this is not independent verification.
DemiJoule reprompt remains unreachable under the current common six-axis score implementation.
P-10 forbidden is source-reachable but only under a narrow KAPPA-derived confidence region; this is a fidelity finding, not a robustness claim.
Synthetic fixtures establish source-bound routing/safety behavior only, not real-workload safety or benefit.
B1 qualification does not establish B2, B3, integrated Track C, or canonical DGAF efficacy.
